name: How long does it take to get French doors ordered and delivered?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get French doors ordered and delivered?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to get French doors ordered and delivered can vary significantly, typically ranging from 4 to 12 weeks. This timeframe depends on whether you choose standard stock sizes or custom-built doors, the manufacturer's lead times, and current supply chain conditions. Specialty glass, unique finishes, or non-standard dimensions will generally extend the waiting period. When working with Hometelligent Inc., we assist with material selection and provide estimated lead times early in the process to help manage project expectations for installations across our service region, including Dublin and Livermore.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ordering and delivery for French doors typically takes 4-12 weeks, depending on customization, manufacturer lead times, and supply chain. We provide estimated lead times.
